requisitionList.Title: Sr. Sales Strategic Account Director
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Sr. Sales Strategic Account Director will lead and manage sales strategies for a key hyperscale customer in the data center industry, driving revenue growth and customer satisfaction.

requisitionList.Title: Equipment Engineering Technician: B-Shift
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: 
The Equipment Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and supporting manufacturing equipment.  Assist and perform in Intermediate repairs/maintenance on equipment used in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices in a clean room environment. Using both learned and applied skills.

requisitionList.Title: Lead Project Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Lead Engineer leads a small team of engineers while providing technical and project leadership for engineering, manufacturing, and new product development initiatives. Responsible for managing projects from concept through production, this role ensures execution within scope, schedule, and budget. The position supports projects involving advanced materials, precision machining, and metrology, while driving successful product transfers to manufacturing through equipment specification, process documentation, training, and performance monitoring. The Lead Engineer also promotes continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, FMEA, and yield enhancement initiatives, collaborating closely with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.

requisitionList.Title: Crystal Fabrication Technician
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: Currently seeking a Optical / Semiconductor Fabrication Technician to support the R&D, production, and high volume manufacturing of laser optic products in our Budd Lake NJ facility. Responsibilities include crystal fabrication, support maintenance related fabrication and machining equipment,

Must be willing to work 12-hour shifts on a 4/3 day rotating schedule.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Business Analytics Manager
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Senior Business Analytics Manager as a Service for Product Management provides centralized, high-quality analytics and business analysis support to Product Management and business leadership. This role combines business analytics, market and product analysis, reporting system development, data governance, requirements analysis, and cross-functional communication to help Product Managers identify opportunities, manage risks, improve revenue and margin performance, and make timely, data-driven decisions. The role leverages enterprise-approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and digital technologies to enhance analytics, improve productivity, automate routine business processes, and enable faster, data-driven decision-making while adhering to company data governance and security standards.

requisitionList.Title: Temp - Coating Lab Technician
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Coating Lab Technician to join our team in our East Granby, CT facility where we develop and produce specialty optical fiber.  

This temp role is a part-time position for 3 months, 25 hours per week, and will support the production and quality assurance of advanced optical fiber coatings.

requisitionList.Title: Head of Finance
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: Coherent is seeking a proven leader to join our Finance team in Santa Clara, CA. This highly visible role will support our EVP of a significant Business Group (BG) within the Datacenter & Communications segment.

As the finance business partner for one of our significant BG, this person will help shape the business strategy as well as the success of this dynamic and geographically diverse team. While ensuring an adequate control environment, this role leads financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, forward cost accounting for growth, and financial reporting of the BG. The position also ensures industry trends impacting the divisions, Business Units (BU) in the BG, including economic issues, competition, pricing, and disruptive technologies are identified, understood and addressed by the BG leadership team.

requisitionList.Title: DMTS of OCS System and Test Architecture
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: 
The Distinguished Member of Technical Staff (DMTS, Director level) of OCS System Architecture & Test Engineering leads the organizations responsible for the end-to-end Optical Circuit Switch (OCS) product system architecture and verification strategy. The scope spans the OCS engine and chassis, optics/photonics, electrical hardware, ASIC/FPGA, firmware, software, management interfaces, fiber connectivity, and development and manufacturing test. This director translates customer product and operational requirements into system and test feature requirements; establishes technical governance and organizational capability; and is accountable for robust, scalable, manufacturable, cost-effective solutions from concept through production and sustaining.

requisitionList.Title: Member of Technical Staff, Silicon Photonics Integration
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: The Member of Technical Staff, Silicon Photonics Integration is a senior individual-contributor role. The position is responsible for defining and driving end-to-end integration of silicon-photonics-based optical engines and modules, with an initial product focus on coherent transmission. 

This technical authority translates system and product objectives into PIC/EIC, optical, electrical, package, thermal, mechanical, firmware/calibration, manufacturing, and test requirements; leads cross-functional studies and execution from concept through qualification and volume ramp; and represents integration decisions with internal teams, suppliers, and customers. The role leads matrixed workstreams and mentors engineers; direct people management is not the primary scope.

requisitionList.Title: Facility Maintenance Technician
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Facility Maintenance Technician is responsible for performing a variety of skilled maintenance and repair tasks to ensure the efficient and reliable operation of a 24/7/365 facility. This role requires a high level of technical expertise and the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues related to building systems, equipment, and infrastructure.

requisitionList.Title: SIOP Lead NA, Industrial
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
The Senior Manager, Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (S&OP) is responsible for leading the Industrial Segment's end-to-end planning process and serving as the primary business partner for commercial, operations, product management, manufacturing, procurement, and finance teams. The role is accountable for developing a balanced demand, supply, inventory, and revenue plan across a 3-to-24-month planning horizon while driving operational execution, inventory optimization, and profitable growth.
This position serves as the focal point for Industrial Segment S&OP governance, facilitating cross-functional decision making, identifying risks and opportunities, resolving supply-demand imbalances, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and operational capabilities. The successful candidate will drive planning excellence, process standardization, analytics, and continuous improvement across the Industrial Segment.

requisitionList.Title: Production Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Job Summary: Looking for someone with a Material Science engineering background to support our LPE expansion in Easton, PA.  The qualified candidate will be able to perform system troubleshooting and crystal growth analysis.

requisitionList.Title: Principal Quality Engineer-Optical Systems
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Job Summary: Coherent is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer with deep expertise in optical systems to support new product introduction, production ramp, and sustained manufacturing performance in a fast-paced, startup-like environment. This role is responsible for driving quality excellence across the product lifecycle, from early design engagement through high-volume production. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical background in optical systems, root cause investigation, process improvement, internal audit, and quality systems within a technical manufacturing environment.

requisitionList.Title: Financial Analyst
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: Due to the rapid growth of our business, we are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Financial Analyst to join our Compound Semiconductor Finance team. This role will support the site Controller in all aspects of financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision-making across the fab operations.
The Financial Analyst will be a key partner not only with Finance, but also with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Line Management, and other business functions to analyze financial performance, identify key business drivers, and provide actionable insights to leadership. The ideal candidate will synthesize a strong work ethic, analytical capabilities with an interest in the operational dynamics of semiconductor fab to add valuable feedback to management.

requisitionList.Title: Supply Chain Operations Analyst
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: We are seeking a strategic, analytically exceptional, and operationally versatile Senior Supply Chain Operations Analyst to partner directly with the Chief Procurement Officer (CPO) and the broader supply chain leadership team. This role is designed for a high‑performing individual who thrives in a fast‑moving environment, can independently drive complex initiatives, and brings a strong blend of business acumen, executive‑level communication, and data‑driven problem‑solving. The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating at both the strategic and tactical levels.

requisitionList.Title: Test Technician 2
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: 
Works on assignments that are semi-routine in nature where ability to recognize deviation from accepted practice is required. Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new assignments. Requires experience in testing digital and/or analog systems. Ability to read drawings and use measurement instruments. Typically, an AA degree, military technical training or their equivalent vocational training is required.

Description for Internal Candidates
We are seeking a Test Technician to aid in the production of high-power CO2 lasers in our Bloomfield, CT facility. This position requires individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, technically demanding and constantly evolving product landscape. Standard schedule is Monday - Friday, 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Principal Optical Integration Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Job Summary: This role will be responsible for integration of optoelectronic components for advanced Co-Packaged Optics and Optical Engine products. This will include silicon photonics chip (PIC),  electrical IC (EIC), control unit, organic substrate, and integration of lasers. Candidate will need to work with internal design and process teams, as well as external suppliers to ensure the final laser integrated CPO and Light Engine product meets performance specifications and bring products from concept to production with good yield and reliability.

requisitionList.Title: Production Planner
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Job Summary: The Production Planner supports production schedules and materials in a high mix / low volume manufacturing environment, including prototype and specialized custom TE module builds. This position works with a cross-functional team including engineering, customer service, purchasing, finance, manufacturing, and shipping/receiving to support daily planning activities. The Production Planner assists in executing production planning processes, including work order generation, and BOM validation, and serves as a key link between manufacturing, engineering, customer service, and purchasing. This role also supports the review and reporting of manufacturing performance metrics and contributes to overall production planning operations

requisitionList.Title: Facility Senior Maintenance Technician
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: We are seeking a Facility Maintenance Technician to support our operations located in Bloomfield, CT.  This role performs work of average to considerable difficulty in the journey-level performance of “Building & equipment maintenance” to include the primary fields of:  Electrical, electronics, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, vacuum systems, and may perform other lower-level tasks as assigned.

requisitionList.Title: Coat Tech Sr. - 2nd Shift
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary:  We are seeking an Optical Coating Technician in our Budd Lake, NJ facility.This role is responsible for inspecting, cleaning, and loading optical substrates into coating chambers for thin film deposition.  Approx. 70% of the time will be cleaning & fixturing optical crystals.  The other 30% will be used for loading coating recipes, running the coating chamber & performing reflectivity testing using spectrophotometers and laser measurements.  

This is a 2nd shift position:  ~11:30am - 8:00pm  M - F  with 10% shift differential

requisitionList.Title: Coat Tech Sr.

This role is responsible for inspecting, cleaning, and loading optical substrates into coating chambers for thin film deposition.  Approx. 70% of the time will be cleaning & fixturing optical crystals.  The other 30% will be used for loading coating recipes, running the coating chamber & performing reflectivity testing using spectrophotometers and laser measurements.

requisitionList.Title: Assembly Engineering Supervisor
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Assembly Supervisor is responsible for leading all production activities within a high-precision laser component assembly manufacturing environment. This role oversees production personnel, manufacturing processes, quality performance, safety compliance, delivery execution, and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership skills, experience in electro-optical or photonics manufacturing, and a proven ability to drive operational excellence in a fast-paced production setting.

requisitionList.Title: Laser Processing Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Coherent Corp is seeking a Laser Processing Engineer to join our R&D team. This role will focus on developing laser machining processes for advanced thermal management components, offering an exciting opportunity for a technical graduate with a passion for lasers and mechanical systems.

As a Laser Processing Engineer, you will play a crucial role in our R&D department. Your primary responsibility will be to design and optimize laser machining processes for high-end thermal management components, ensuring efficient and effective solutions. This role is ideal for a recent graduate with a technical degree, offering an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience and contribute to innovative projects.

requisitionList.Title: Director, Government Contracts Counsel
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: Coherent is seeking a Director, Government Contracts Counsel (U.S.) to serve as the company’s principal legal subject-matter expert for U.S. federal government and defense contracting. This senior individual-contributor role will establish and lead Coherent’s enterprise-wide approach to government-contract compliance, governance, and risk management.
The Director will advise executive leadership and business teams on FAR, DFARS, CMMC, and related federal contracting requirements. Working across Legal, engineering, IT, cybersecurity, supply chain, finance, and program management, this individual will translate complex requirements into practical business guidance and scalable processes that support Coherent’s growth in the defense and federal markets.
This position will operate with significant autonomy and serve as the company’s primary legal authority for U.S. government-contracting matters.

requisitionList.Title: Planning Expeditor JR
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: JR. Planning Expeditor for our Budd Lake, New Jersey facility.  Will work with planners to expedite work orders and purchase orders. Provide planning support to growth department.
